meta.name: airflow-dag-patterns
meta.description: Build production Apache Airflow DAGs with best practices for operators, sensors, testing, and deployment. Use when creating data pipelines, orchestrating workflows, or scheduling batch jobs.

copy.tagline: 构建生产级的数据管道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是数据工程师,用 Airflow 编排任务,想写出更规范的 DAG。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage data pipelines and want reliable, maintainable DAGs.

howto.what: Claude 会按 Apache Airflow 生产实践帮你写 DAG：设计任务依赖、配置算子与传感器、重试和超时、本地测试与部署；产出是可用的 DAG 代码和配置建议。
howto.when: 当你创建数据管道、编排工作流或调度批处理任务时触发；设计 DAG 结构、实现自定义算子或传感器、排查失败的 DAG 运行时也会用到。

say.text: 用 Airflow 写一个每天跑的 ETL DAG，带重试和超时。
say.note: 生成含依赖、参数和调度的 DAG 代码。

say.text: 给我的 DAG 加一个 mode='reschedule' 的传感器。
say.note: 按建议写法改传感器配置。

say.text: 这个 DAG 运行失败了，帮我看看原因。
say.note: 分析失败任务与重试设置。

howto.what_en: Claude writes Apache Airflow DAG code using production patterns: task dependencies, operators and sensors, retries and timeouts, local testing, and deployment. Output is DAG files plus configuration advice.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you create data pipelines, orchestrate workflows, or schedule batch jobs; also when designing DAG structures, implementing custom operators or sensors, or debugging failed DAG runs.

say_en.text: Write a daily ETL DAG in Airflow with retries and timeouts.
say_en.note: Produces DAG code with dependencies and schedule.

say_en.text: Add a sensor with mode='reschedule' to my DAG.
Help me debug why this DAG run failed.
say_en.note: Reviews failing tasks and retry settings.
